channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Toumani Camara | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Toumani Camara from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Micah Nori on Deni Avdija, Donovan Clingan, Toumani Camara
item.description:
“He’s excited to be on a team with vets like Dame and Jrue, and he loves the young talent of Deni (Avdija), Scoot, (Donovan) Clingan, (Toumani) Camara … I mean, he mentioned them all by name,”

Micah Nori on Deni Avdija, Donovan Clingan, Toumani Camara, Jul 1, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Devin Booker on Toumani Camara
item.description:
Devin Booker on how Toumani Camara has improved since his short time in Phoenix:

“He's gotten a lot more confident, he's gotten a lot more physical. ... He's one of the best defenders in the league.”

Devin Booker on Toumani Camara, Apr 13, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Toumani Camara
item.description:
Joe Cronin on Toumani Camara's All-Defense selection:

“We're excited for Toumani and thrilled that he's getting the recognition he deserves. Toumani's aspirations are big — he's just getting started.”

Joe Cronin on Toumani Camara, May 22, 2025. Source: x.com.
